Navigate into the 'Eliminator ver 1.2_Data' folder inside the game install folder Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the 'Kaede_patch.moyashi' file from the downloaded patch archive into the 'Eliminator ver 1.2_Data' folder mentioned above
